name: application-anomaly-alert-row
title: Anomaly Alert Row
description: Metric row for anomaly monitoring: name and expected-range/current-value text, a sparkline with a shaded expected band and a spike marker, and a severity badge.
useWhen: Building an observability or monitoring dashboard where metrics need to show whether they're within an expected range.
You want a compact sparkline showing the expected band alongside the actual trend, not just a bare number.
Pairing with Environment Switcher or Feature Flag Toggle Row in an ops/admin panel.
avoidWhen: The metric has no meaningful "expected range" concept — a plain Trend Sparkbar Row or Stat Tile is enough.
You need a full interactive time-series chart with zoom/pan — this is a compact glanceable row, not a chart component.
responsiveBehavior: Each row is a single flex line; the sparkline and badge are fixed-width and never shrink, while the metric name/range text truncates or wraps first on narrow viewports.
accessibility: Severity is conveyed by both badge color and visible text ("Normal", "Warning", "Critical"), never color alone.
The expected range and current value are always stated as text next to the sparkline, so the anomaly is understandable without interpreting the chart.
The sparkline SVG is aria-hidden since its information is fully redundant with the adjacent text.

variants.title: Anomaly Alert Row
variants.description: Three metric rows: a Critical API error rate spike, a Warning checkout latency spike, and a Normal signup conversion rate within its expected band.
accessibility: Each row's severity badge text names the state explicitly rather than relying on the sparkline color alone.

variants.title: Anomaly Alert Row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three metric rows adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Sparkline and badge colors remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
